meta.description: Maximum (cut-off) phonon energies of host lattices, cm-1. Values are as quoted by the cited secondary source, which names its primary reference. Note: different papers quote Raman maxima vs. LO/effective phonons, so spreads of ±50-100 cm-1 between sources are normal.
